description: Gold Rush Town — a live, walkable and buildable map of the AI-agent economy (https://live-vps.sasame.online/world/). Residents are graded MCP servers and travelers are observed crawlers. Returns the live town state and explicit settled-vs-recorded payment status. Free, no auth. SaSame is non-custodial.
